top_signals.title: Nvidia Weighs on US Index Futures as CEO Uncertainty Hits Shares
top_signals.summary: US stock index futures slid as Nvidia Corp. considers replacing Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, with the AI chipmaker’s drop making up over half of the Nasdaq 100 contracts’ declines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nvidia board meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s fate stretches into evening
top_signals.summary: Nvidia's board is meeting days after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
